title: More Of The Best Of Bill Cosby 8 Track Stereo Tape Cartridge - Warner Bros.
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track stereo tape cartridge of "More Of The Best Of Bill Cosby" released by Warner Bros. The comedy album features original cover art and is in stereo format, making it a sought-after collector's item for fans of Bill Cosby's iconic humor. This edition is a compilation of the best works from the famous comedian, providing listeners with a nostalgic and entertaining listening experience.
